query_text: For a first-time homebuyer comparing mortgage options, use this rate table and tell me which loan is likely cheapest over the first 5 years and over the full term. Assume a $320,000 home price, 20% down, 30-year horizon unless the term differs, buyer has a 740 credit score, and will keep the home for at least 7 years. Ignore taxes and insurance unless needed for explanation. Loan options: [{"name":"30-year fixed A","rate":6.25,"points":0,"lender_fees":1800,"term_years":30},{"name":"30-year fixed B","rate":5.875,"points":1.5,"lender_fees":2200,"term_years":30},{"name":"15-year fixed C","rate":5.1,"points":0.5,"lender_fees":1600,"term_years":15},{"name":"5/1 ARM D","rate":5.4,"points":0,"lender_fees":1400,"term_years":30,"fixed_years":5}]. Please show estimated monthly principal-and-interest payments, upfront closing-cost differences from points/fees, tradeoffs, and a plain-English recommendation with caveats.

Movie night for four: recommend 8 films we could choose from based on these preferences, then rank the top 3 and explain why. Group preferences: Person A loves clever sci-fi and mystery like Arrival and Ex Machina, Person B wants low gore and no jump scares, Person C prefers fast pacing and under 2 hours, Person D likes emotional character arcs and a satisfying ending. Avoid musicals, heavy war themes, and anything more graphic than a typical PG-13. Mix recent and older films, all in English, and include for each pick: genre, runtime, tone, a one-sentence spoiler-free hook, and a note on why it fits the group.

Which of these laptops is the best buy for a university student majoring in computer science who has a budget of $1,200, wants at least 16GB RAM, at least 512GB SSD storage, battery life over 8 hours, and a weight under 1.8kg? Please rank them and explain the trade-offs. Options: 1) Acer Swift X 14 — $1,099, Intel Core Ultra 7 155H, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 1.55kg, 10-hour battery, 14.5" 2880x1800 OLED. 2) ASUS Zenbook 14 — $999, Ryzen 7 8840HS, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 1.28kg, 12-hour battery, 14" 1920x1200 OLED. 3) Dell Inspiron 14 Plus — $1,149, Intel Core Ultra 7 155H, 32GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 1.67kg, 7-hour battery, 14" 2560x1600 IPS. 4) MacBook Air 13 M3 — $1,199, Apple M3, 16GB unified memory, 512GB SSD, 1.24kg, 15-hour battery, 13.6" 2560x1664. I mostly use VS Code, Docker, browser tabs, Python, and light photo editing.

Please pick the best hotel option for a family trip from the list below and explain why. Trip details: 2 adults and 2 children (ages 6 and 9), traveling from Madrid, Spain to Rome, Italy from 2025-09-12 to 2025-09-16. Need 1 room that sleeps 4 or 2 connecting rooms, breakfast included if possible, max total hotel budget €900 for 4 nights, walking distance to a metro stop, and quiet at night. Rank these options and recommend the best one: 1) Hotel A: €820 total, family room for 4, breakfast included, 7-minute walk to metro, quiet street, no free cancellation. 2) Hotel B: €760 total, 2 double rooms, breakfast not included, 3-minute walk to metro, busy nightlife area, free cancellation. 3) Hotel C: €910 total, family suite for 4, breakfast included, 5-minute walk to metro, quiet area, free cancellation. 4) Hotel D: €680 total, family room for 4, no breakfast, 15-minute walk to metro, quiet area, free cancellation. Include a short comparison table and a final recommendation.

Please summarize this weather forecast for Kyoto, Japan for 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13 (JST) and recommend the best two half-days for temple visits and the best evening for a riverside walk. Forecast: 2026-04-10: high 18C, low 9C, rain 70%, wind 14 km/h; 2026-04-11: high 21C, low 11C, rain 10%, wind 8 km/h; 2026-04-12: high 23C, low 13C, rain 20%, wind 10 km/h; 2026-04-13: high 17C, low 8C, rain 80%, wind 18 km/h. I prefer mild temperatures, low rain risk, and lighter wind. Give packing advice too.

Map out a 7-day family trip to Japan for 2 adults and 1 child (age 8) from 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-11. We will arrive in Tokyo and depart from Osaka. Total budget is 320000 JPY excluding international flights. Priorities: kid-friendly activities, one day at a theme park, easy public transport, minimal hotel changes, and not more than 3 major activities per day. We prefer mid-range food, no seafood, and walking no more than 12000 steps per day on average. Please provide a day-by-day itinerary, estimated cost breakdown by category, suggested areas to stay, and a packing checklist for mild spring weather.

Map out a focused work plan for 2026-09-14 in America/New_York for one person working from home. I have 8 hours available from 09:00 to 17:00, a 30-minute lunch break, and I want deep-work blocks in the morning. Tasks: finish quarterly report draft (3h, high priority), reply to client emails (45m, medium), prepare 10-slide team update (1h 30m, high), review budget spreadsheet (1h, medium), submit expense report (30m, low), and plan next week (45m, medium). Constraints: no meetings before 11:00, batch email once, include two 10-minute breaks, and leave the final 20 minutes as buffer. Give me a time-blocked schedule plus a short explanation of why the order works.

Put together a 5-day vegetarian dinner plan for 2 adults with recipes and a consolidated shopping list. Constraints: total grocery budget under $75 USD, active cooking time 30 minutes or less per meal, at least 25 g protein per serving, no mushrooms, no peanuts, and only one meal can use pasta. We have a stovetop, oven, blender, and microwave. Pantry staples already on hand: olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic, cumin, paprika, dried oregano, soy sauce, rice, and red lentils. Please include estimated cost per meal, brief cooking steps, and ideas for using leftovers efficiently.

For a move in October 2026, compare three neighborhoods in Lisbon, Portugal for a renter working near Marquês de Pombal: Campo de Ourique, Areeiro, and Alcântara. My budget is €1,500/month max for a 1-bedroom apartment, I prefer a commute under 35 minutes by public transport, quiet streets, good grocery access, and a gym nearby. I do not have children and I do not need nightlife. Give me a side-by-side comparison, likely tradeoffs, and which area best fits my priorities.

My Windows 11 laptop keeps disconnecting from Wi-Fi every 10–15 minutes after waking from sleep. Device: Lenovo IdeaPad 5, Intel AX201 adapter, Windows 11 Home 23H2. Router works fine for other devices. I already restarted the laptop and router, forgot and rejoined the network, and updated Windows. Please give me a one-session troubleshooting plan in priority order, including the exact settings to check in Device Manager, Power Options, and network adapter properties, plus command-line diagnostics I can run and how to interpret the results. End with a short decision tree for when to suspect the router, driver, or hardware.

Write two contrasting opening paragraphs for a literary short story about a night-shift archivist who discovers a box of letters that appear to be written by her future self. One opening should feel quietly atmospheric and introspective, and the other should feel tense and suspenseful. Use third-person limited, keep each paragraph between 140 and 180 words, avoid clichés about dusty libraries, and make the protagonist seem competent rather than quirky.

Please draft a clear event schedule for a one-day university research symposium on 2026-10-14 in Singapore Time (SGT, UTC+8). The event runs from 08:30 to 17:30 for 120 attendees with 1 main hall and 3 breakout rooms. Required items: registration 08:30-09:00, opening remarks 09:00-09:15, keynote 09:15-10:00, coffee break 10:00-10:20, two parallel breakout sessions before lunch, lunch 12:00-13:00, poster session 13:00-14:00, panel discussion 14:15-15:00, coffee break 15:00-15:20, one workshop block 15:20-16:20, closing remarks 16:30-16:45, networking 16:45-17:30. Add room assignments, keep 10 minutes of buffer when possible, avoid overlapping keynote/panel/closing with any other sessions, and present the result as a table plus a short list of organizer notes.

For a market research memo, analyze this fictional electric scooter sales dataset and give me: 1) the three most important trends, 2) a segment-by-segment interpretation, 3) two chart recommendations with what each chart should show, 4) likely business risks, and 5) three specific actions for the next quarter. Dataset (units sold, average selling price in USD, return rate): Q1 North-America commuter 4200 540 4.2%; Q1 North-America premium 1200 890 3.1%; Q1 Europe commuter 3900 520 4.8%; Q1 Europe premium 1500 910 2.9%; Q2 North-America commuter 4600 530 4.5%; Q2 North-America premium 1350 880 3.0%; Q2 Europe commuter 4100 515 5.0%; Q2 Europe premium 1650 905 2.7%; Q3 North-America commuter 5100 525 4.9%; Q3 North-America premium 1600 870 3.3%; Q3 Europe commuter 4450 510 5.4%; Q3 Europe premium 1820 895 2.8%; Q4 North-America commuter 5900 520 5.3%; Q4 North-America premium 2100 860 3.6%; Q4 Europe commuter 4700 505 5.8%; Q4 Europe premium 2050 890 3.0%. Please calculate approximate revenue by segment and keep the write-up concise but insight-dense.

Between these two job offers, which is better for me over a 3-year horizon? Offer A: Senior Data Analyst in Berlin, Germany, salary €78,000 gross, 10% annual bonus target, 30 vacation days, hybrid 2 days/week in office, pension match 3%, commute 25 minutes each way, likely promotion in 24 months. Offer B: Analytics Manager in Madrid, Spain, salary €62,000 gross, 15% annual bonus target, 25 vacation days, fully remote, no pension match, annual training budget €2,000, higher title but smaller company. My profile: 7 years of experience, I value career growth 40%, work-life balance 30%, cash compensation 20%, and flexibility 10%. Assume monthly living costs of €2,300 in Berlin and €1,700 in Madrid, and give a weighted comparison table plus a clear recommendation with tradeoffs.

My monthly take-home pay is $4,850. Fixed expenses: rent $1,650, utilities $180, internet $55, phone $45, car payment $320, insurance $140, groceries $520, gym $35, student loan $250. Variable spending last month: dining $210, gas $160, entertainment $95, shopping $180. I want to follow a 50/30/20 budget using my actual numbers. Calculate (1) my total spending, (2) how much I am over or under each 50/30/20 category assuming needs = rent, utilities, internet, phone, car payment, insurance, groceries, gas, student loan; wants = dining, entertainment, shopping, gym; savings = whatever is left, and (3) the exact dollar adjustments needed in wants and/or needs to hit 20% savings.

Plan a 7-day trip to Japan for two adults from 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-18, arriving in Tokyo and departing from Osaka. Total budget is USD 3,200 excluding international flights. We prefer a medium pace, private hotel rooms with private bathrooms, and a mix of food, temples, city neighborhoods, and one nature day. Please include a day-by-day itinerary, estimated costs by category, intercity transport suggestions, and 5 practical packing/tipping/cash tips. We do not want nightlife, luxury shopping, or theme parks.

Plan a 3-day itinerary in Kyoto, Japan for 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-12 for 2 adults with a total sightseeing and food budget of ¥60,000 excluding hotel. We like temples, gardens, traditional streets, and vegetarian-friendly meals, want a moderate pace, prefer public transit and walking, and do not want nightlife or long hikes. Include a day-by-day route order, estimated transit times between stops, meal suggestions, and one rainy-day backup option each day.

My 14-year-old is studying for a Grade 9 biology test on photosynthesis and cellular respiration. Please build a 45-minute study session that includes: a 5-minute warm-up, a clear explanation of both processes in simple language, a comparison table with at least 6 differences, 8 practice questions with answers, 2 memory tricks, and a 5-question mini quiz at the end. Keep it self-contained and suitable for a student who gets distracted easily.

Draft a clear, beginner-friendly onboarding guide for new employees on how to use a company knowledge base effectively. The guide should be self-contained and include: 1) what a knowledge base is, 2) how to search efficiently using keywords, filters, and article structure, 3) how to judge whether a document is trustworthy or outdated, 4) when to escalate to a manager instead of relying on documentation, 5) common mistakes to avoid, and 6) a one-page quick-start checklist. Write it in plain English for office staff with low technical confidence, using headings, bullet points, and a short example scenario.

Movie night recommendation request: pick 5 films from this list for a two-person evening, then rank them from best fit to worst fit based on these preferences: no horror, minimal gore, under 130 minutes, strong character development, and a satisfying ending. We usually like sci-fi, mystery, and smart comedies. Available options with runtimes and genres: Arrival (116 min, sci-fi/drama), Knives Out (130 min, mystery/comedy), Ex Machina (108 min, sci-fi/thriller), The Nice Guys (116 min, comedy/mystery), Prisoners (153 min, thriller/drama), Palm Springs (90 min, rom-com/sci-fi), Gone Girl (149 min, thriller/mystery), The Martian (144 min, sci-fi/adventure), Game Night (100 min, comedy/mystery), Her (126 min, sci-fi/romance). For each pick, give a one-sentence reason and note any content cautions.

On my Android phone, a QR code scanner opens but won’t read codes from a laptop screen. Give me a step-by-step troubleshooting checklist that covers camera focus, brightness, permissions, screen glare, distance, damaged codes, app settings, and privacy/safety tips for scanning unknown QR codes.

Review this weekly project status snapshot and tell me which workstream is on track, which is at risk, and which needs immediate escalation. Then summarize the top 3 blockers and the most important action for each. Data: [{"workstream":"Backend API","planned_progress":80,"actual_progress":78,"blocked_days":1,"open_issues":4,"severity":"medium"},{"workstream":"Mobile App","planned_progress":75,"actual_progress":60,"blocked_days":4,"open_issues":9,"severity":"high"},{"workstream":"Data Migration","planned_progress":50,"actual_progress":52,"blocked_days":0,"open_issues":2,"severity":"low"},{"workstream":"QA Automation","planned_progress":65,"actual_progress":58,"blocked_days":2,"open_issues":6,"severity":"medium"}]. Use a simple RAG-style status label for each workstream.

Draft a notification schedule for a medication reminder app for this scenario: one adult in Toronto, Canada (America/Toronto timezone) takes levothyroxine at 07:00 daily on an empty stomach, vitamin D at 12:30 daily with lunch, and amoxicillin 500 mg every 8 hours from 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-17 inclusive. Quiet hours are 22:00-06:30. Include exact reminder times, notification titles, short message text, and rules for snooze, missed doses, and duplicate-notification prevention.

Given this monthly budget data, recommend a practical 50/30/20-style budget adjustment plan and a 6-month debt payoff strategy. Net monthly income: $4,200. Fixed expenses: rent $1,450, utilities $180, internet $60, phone $55, insurance $210, car payment $320, minimum debt payments $140. Variable expenses: groceries $520, gas $210, dining out $340, subscriptions $95, shopping $260, entertainment $180, miscellaneous $150. Debts: credit card A $2,400 at 24% APR with $60 minimum, credit card B $1,200 at 19% APR with $35 minimum, personal loan $3,800 at 11% APR with $45 minimum. Savings: emergency fund $900. Constraints: keep dining out at least $120, keep one streaming subscription, and avoid cutting groceries below $450. Show the revised category amounts, how much extra goes to debt each month, which payoff method you chose and why, and a month-by-month payoff outline for 6 months.

My father is 68 and has type 2 diabetes, mild hypertension, and knee osteoarthritis. He takes metformin 500 mg twice daily and lisinopril 10 mg daily, is allergic to shellfish, and wants a simple 7-day meal plan for weight loss and steadier blood sugar. Please keep it informational only, not a diagnosis. Constraints: about 1800 calories per day, moderate carbs, low sodium, high fiber, no shellfish, minimal cooking time (30 minutes max per meal), budget about $90 total for the week, and include breakfast, lunch, dinner, and one snack each day. Also provide a grocery list grouped by category and 5 practical tips for meal timing and portion control.

Please draft a plain-English checklist and a sample demand letter for a tenant in Ontario, Canada. Scenario: I rented a condo in Toronto under a 12-month lease from 2023-09-01 to 2024-08-31, paid a CAD 2,400 last-month rent deposit at move-in, gave written notice on 2024-07-01 that I would not renew, and moved out on 2024-08-31 after returning the keys. The landlord emailed on 2024-09-10 saying they will keep CAD 900 from my deposit for wall repainting, carpet cleaning, and replacing two blinds, but there was no major damage beyond normal wear. I want a practical next-steps guide, what records to gather, key tenant-rights issues to look into, and a firm but professional letter asking for the withheld amount back within 14 days. Do not give a final legal ruling; frame it as general legal information for Ontario and include a short section on when to escalate to the Landlord and Tenant Board.

Moving to Lisbon, Portugal in September 2026, I want a ranked shortlist of 5 neighborhoods to rent in for a 12-month lease. My budget is €1,900/month max, I need a 2-bedroom apartment of at least 70 m², and my priorities are: under 35 minutes by public transport to Oriente station during weekday mornings, safe streets for walking at night, good grocery access, and a quiet environment suitable for remote work. I do not need nightlife. Please compare neighborhoods on commute, typical housing fit for my budget, family-friendliness, noise level, and trade-offs, then give a final recommendation table.

Map out a career transition plan for me from customer support to junior data analyst. I have 3 years of experience in SaaS support, strong Excel skills, basic SQL, no Python yet, and can study 8 hours per week for 6 months. I live in Toronto, Canada and want roles in Toronto or remote within Canada. My compensation target is CAD 65,000 to 75,000. Please give me a step-by-step roadmap, a prioritized skill list, 3 portfolio project ideas, a resume repositioning summary, and a realistic job-search strategy that works without going back to school full-time.

For a dinner outing in Lisbon, Portugal on 2026-09-12 at 19:30, compare these restaurant options and recommend the best two for a group of 4. Preferences: Portuguese or Mediterranean food, one vegetarian diner, no shellfish, budget up to 25 EUR per person before drinks, quiet enough for conversation, and no more than a 15-minute walk from Rossio Square. Candidate list: 1) Taberna do Bairro — Portuguese tapas, 18-24 EUR pp, 12-minute walk, usually lively/noisy, vegetarian options: 2; 2) Verde Mesa — Mediterranean, 20-26 EUR pp, 10-minute walk, quiet, vegetarian options: 6; 3) Casa do Fado Grill — Portuguese, 22-30 EUR pp, 14-minute walk, live music, vegetarian options: 1; 4) Olive & Hearth — Mediterranean, 16-22 EUR pp, 17-minute walk, quiet, vegetarian options: 4; 5) Pateo Central — Portuguese, 19-23 EUR pp, 8-minute walk, moderate noise, vegetarian options: 3. Give a ranked recommendation with brief reasoning and suggest what each person could order.

Our apartment's kitchen sink has been draining slowly for two weeks and now makes a gurgling sound after the dishwasher runs. It's a 2-bedroom apartment, the issue is only in the kitchen, and there is no standing water or sewage smell. Please give me a one-turn troubleshooting and service plan: likely causes ranked by probability, safe DIY steps I can try in under 30 minutes using common household items, warning signs that mean I should stop and call a plumber, what to ask when hiring a drain-cleaning service, and a reasonable budget breakdown for DIY vs professional repair in USD. Constraints: I rent, I can't disassemble pipes inside the wall, I want to avoid harsh chemical drain cleaners, and I need the sink usable again within 48 hours.

My 2016 Honda Civic EX with 118,000 miles has started making a squealing noise for the first 2–3 minutes after a cold start, especially in damp weather. The battery is 2 years old, the serpentine belt was last replaced at 70,000 miles, and there is no warning light on. I drive about 35 miles per day in stop-and-go traffic and want to spend no more than $450 in the next month. Give me the most likely causes ranked by probability, a step-by-step diagnostic checklist I can do at home with basic tools, which repairs are urgent vs safe to monitor for 2–4 weeks, and a practical repair plan that fits my budget.
